rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Agent Module provides deterministic, structured compliance knowledge mapped to EU AI Act articles. Agents can retrieve applicable ethics nodes as building blocks for internal compliance systems, benchmark actions against validated protocol, and collect proof of compliance effort via semantic telemetry. The server offers four content layers per module — logic gates with statutory citations, procedural directives, domain knowledge chunks, and pre-validated executable templates. It covers data sovereignty, transparency, human oversight, bias detection, cybersecurity, and risk management across 22 ethics modules.
